Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses CXMS (Cross-linking Mass Spectrometry) with the MS-cleavable cross-linker DSSO. While the acquisition is described as MS2_MS3, it is a targeted-like approach for cross-link identification rather than standard DIA or DDA. mod_tpp is selected as the closest modifier for structural/topological proteomics (cross-linking). No labeling strategy for quantification was mentioned.

Other experiments like X-ray crystallography and limited proteolysis are complementary but the MS analysis focuses on these specific genetic variants.
